- Drink (looks like a lemonade or pear juice, about 250 ml): about 110 kcal.
- Two cookies (chocolate chip): about 150 kcal each, so about 300 kcal in total.
- Two rice paper rolls (turkey or chicken with lettuce): about 100 kcal each, so about 200 kcal in total.

Together that gives about 670 kcal served. I assumed about 70 kcal would be left over, so the person eats about 600 kcal.
